description: This file defines cultural-specific date and time formatting, parsing rules, and localization data for the Sanskrit (India) locale ('sa-IN') within the DateJS library.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object containing localized date and time format patterns, names, and regex patterns for the Sanskrit (India) culture.

methods.name: Date.today
methods.description: Returns a new Date object representing the current date with time cleared.

methods.name: Date.equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.
